content.title: Sidemen Charity Match 2026 EXACT start time: When does the Wembley clash kick-off?
content.text: THE Sidemen Charity Match will take place at Wembley Stadium TODAY! Sidemen FC are out for revenge after they lost on penalties to YouTube All-Stars following a 9-9 thriller last year. Sign up for the Football newsletter Thank you! YouTube All-Stars won the Sidemen Charity Match in 2025 Credit: Instagram @sidemen KSI will play for YouTube All-Stars this year Credit: Alamy Some huge names are set to feature in the blockbuster charity match once again, with many big online personalities pulling on their boots. A huge twist this year sees THREE members of the Sidemen join AngryGinge and the YouTube All-Stars as they eye back-to-back titles. The 2025 edition of the event raised a mammoth £4.7million for charity and earned more than 20m views on YouTube. This year’s match is in aid of Bright Side and M7 Education and you can donate via the official giving page. What time does the Sidemen Charity Match 2026 kick-off? The Sidemen Charity Match will take place on Saturday, April 18. Kick-off is scheduled for 3pm BST/10am ET. Wembley Stadium will host. How to watch the Sidemen Charity Match 2026? The Sidemen Charity Match will be broadcast LIVE on the Sidemen’s official YouTube channel. The stream begins at 2.10pm BST/9.10am ET. Alternatively, SunSport’s live blog of the match will bring you minute-by-minute coverage. What are the teams?
